title: The Late Summer Again
author: W. M. Hartwell
blurb: Petra Coldharbour, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, has spent seven years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
